targets.label: Copy your total current monthly income (copy line 11 from Official Form 122A-1)

A total-deductions figure corresponds to line 38 'Total deductions' (undefined_104: p8 T13/T14, also the 39b copy T16), though this partial 4-category sum (DIG-62) is not a valid line-38 total either.

targets.label: The number of people used in determining your deductions from income (exemptions on federal return + additional dependents you support)

Current monthly payments on priority debts match no 122A-2 box: line 35 asks for PAST-DUE priority claims (undefined_93 total, undefined_93-1 divided by 60), and current court-ordered support goes on line 19 (undefined_51).

targets.label: Food, clothing, and other items - IRS National Standards amount for the number of people on line 5

Actual food/clothing above the standard (at most 5%) goes on line 30 (undefined_65).

targets.label: Housing and utilities - Insurance and operating expenses: U.S. Trustee chart amount for your county and the number of people on line 5

Housing and utilities - Insurance and operating expenses: ... fill in the dollar amount listed for your county for insurance and operating expenses' and needs the U.S. Trustee chart amount. Rent/mortgage is the line-9 category: a mortgage payment belongs in the 9b table (Quest9B creditor name1 / Quest9B creditor amount1, 60-month average) and actual rent has no 122A-2 box.

targets.label: Housing and utilities - Mortgage or rent expenses: U.S. Trustee chart amount for your county and the number of people on line 5

Utilities are covered by line 8's insurance-and-operating standard; only home-energy costs above that standard go on line 28 (undefined_63), with documentation.
